content: कौस्तुभः [कुस्तुभो जलधिस्तत्र भवः अण्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated gem obtained with 13 other jewels at the churning of the ocean and worn by Viṣṇu on his breast; सकौस्तुभं ह्रेपयतीव कृष्णम् <ls>R. 6. 49</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 10</ls>. .²2 A kind of oil. .²3 A manner of joining the fingers. .²4 A twist of hair on a horseʼs neck; कौस्तुभः स्याद्देवमणौ कण्ठावर्तेऽपि वाजिनाम् <ls>Nm.</ls>
